items.text: Avoid foul language, toxicity, and bringing controversies or external news to the server.
Dramas and public fights = penalty. Problems are resolved by ticket.

rules.title: Child protection
rules.sub: This server includes players of all ages.

items.text: **18+, NSFW or sexual content** Includes buildings, messages, skins and profile pictures.
Any sexual advance towards minors is grounds for expulsion and reporting to the appropriate authorities.
The server remains active 24/7 on a dedicated host. We no longer depend on home electricity or internet.
**Daily Restart:** Once a day, the device automatically restarts to clear RAM. A few minutes of inactivity is normal.
